title: Real sutured Heegaard Floer homology
summary: We develop a theory of real sutured manifolds and a real Heegaard Floer theory for these manifolds. We develop a notion of real nice diagrams, and prove that our invariant is combinatorially computable. Our theory shares many structural properties with Juhász's sutured Floer homology, as does the topological theory of real sutured manifolds with Gabai's original sutured manifold theory. We also show that our invariant has several new structural properties differentiating it from sutured Floer homology.
